title: Classic Axe
body:
-"A retro vibe that somehow distorts tree chopping sounds!"-

The Classic Axe is a special axe that was added for Oaklands' second anniversary alongside the Classic Island area, making it easier to reach the Classic Store than it used to be via traveling through the Desert Highlands.

Appearance

The Classic Axe takes appearance of two brick parts with studs on the top and inlets on the bottom, being comprised of colors that seem to be Bright orange and Medium stone grey.

Obtaining

Place a Steel Axe in front of the Noob in the Classic Biome and interact with him to transfer the Steel Axe for a Classic Axe. It has the same stats as Steel Axe.
